seconds_per_sample_basis: model_inference_seconds / num_samples. Includes JIT compilation (single model call in the process, no warm-up). Excludes process start-up, model build, parameter loading, featurisation, sample extraction and output writing.
timing_sources: model_inference_seconds, featurisation_seconds, sample_extraction_seconds: AlphaFold3's own log lines in notebooks/af3_cpu_colab.ipynb cell 14. wall_clock_*: time.time() around the run_alphafold.py subprocess in the same cell; these values were previously published as total_inference_seconds and seconds_per_sample. non_inference_overhead_*: wall_clock_total_seconds - model_inference_seconds (derived).
